description: This file contains implementation of a function 'GetPredOutside' that performs motion compensated prediction for video decoding, specifically handling boundary conditions when motion vectors point outside the Video Object Plane (VOP). It includes boundary padding and pixel interpolation logic.

methods.name: GetPredOutside
methods.description: Performs motion compensated prediction for blocks outside the VOP boundary, including boundary padding and pixel interpolation, then computes prediction values by adding residuals.
